title: Protocol
description: The WebSocket protocol between the app and the go-server: for every request type its request and response. The single source for the TypeScript types (npm run generate:protocol) and checked against the real server in go-server/integration_test.go.

tile.description: Tile chosen in the add-on (ReGa metadata)

mode.description: Input channels (MULTI_MODE_INPUT_TRANSMITTER): what they are wired to, the WebUI's metadata channelMode (0 off, 1 key, 2 switch, 3 contact, 4 level, 5 condition); missing means key

Channel.description: A channel as ReGa knows it, with its current values

updatable.description: The device can get a firmware update (UPDATABLE)

interface.description: BidCos-RF: the radio module the device is assigned to

updatable.description: The device can get a firmware update (UPDATABLE)

interface.description: BidCos-RF: the radio module the device is assigned to

channel.description: The channel the variable belongs to

operate.description: Users other than administrators may run it ("bedienbar")

internal.description: A system-internal program (the WebUI lists them on request)

GetChannelsRequest.description: Channels of a room, a trade, a favorite list or (all) of all devices

SubscribeRequest.description: Events for these channels (replacing the previous list)

elevatedUntil.description: RFC 3339 time the admin rights end; absent without an expiry or when not elevated

sgtin.description: HmIP: pair only this device, with its local key, without the key server

key.description: The device key from the label (base32 or 32 hex digits)

keyMismatch.description: BidCos-RF: a device that failed to pair for another system security key

noAutoLogin.description: Logged out on purpose: no automatic login

elevatedUntil.description: RFC 3339 time the admin rights end; absent without an expiry or when not elevated

ErrorResponse.description: A failed request; requestId if the request had one

EventMessage.description: A value reported by the CCU for a subscribed channel

SysvarsMessage.description: Sent unasked to connections that loaded the system variables (getSysvars) when they changed; the whole list. System variables send no events, the server reads them every few seconds

AlarmMessagesMessage.description: Sent unasked to connections that loaded the alarms (getAlarmMessages) when they changed; the whole list. The server reads them every 15 s while an app shows them

ServiceMessagesMessage.description: Sent unasked to connections that loaded the service messages (getServiceMessages) when they changed; the whole list. The server reads them again after an event of a service datapoint (UNREACH, LOW_BAT ...) and every 5 minutes

RadioInterface.description: A radio module with its duty cycle (percent of the allowed transmit time used)

ServiceMessage.description: An active service message of the CCU

type.description: The datapoint that raised it, e.g. STICKY_UNREACH

url.description: Where to download the backup, once and within 5 minutes

active.description: Whether the alarm variable is still set

Favorite.description: A favorite list of the CCU user

tile.description: The tile shown for the channel; empty lets the app decide

ProgramDefinition.description: A program with its WENN / SONST WENN rules and the SONST branch

leftType.description: ivtObjectId, ivtSystemId, ivtCurrentDate, ivtEmpty or N:<number>

param.description: ivtObjectId, ivtSystemId, ivtString (script), ivtEmpty or N:<number>

InterfaceLink.description: A direct link and the interface it belongs to

endpoint.description: the device's push endpoint, if subscribed

rules.description: notified when a notification rule holds

time.description: the CCU's local time, YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS

canPower.description: whether reboot and shutdown work (the add-on runs on the CCU)

timeServers.description: The time servers (ntpclient), if the file is there

timeZones.description: The time zones to choose from, if time.conf is there

regaVersion.description: the chosen logic layer, only where the CCU has both (eQ-3 firmware; OpenCCU ships one)

fullName.description: login name without spaces; first name up to the first space, as in the WebUI

password.description: only to set it; the WebUI's allowed characters

autoLogin.description: Log in automatically as this user (ignored for administrators)

showLogin.description: shown on the WebUI's login page

autoLogin.description: Logged in automatically without a password (UsersDefaultLogin); one user at most, never an administrator

channel.description: only the entries of this channel (0: all)

HistoryEntry.description: One entry of the system protocol (dom.GetHistoryData)

group.description: entries of one event share a group

text.description: the value as the WebUI writes it (system variables)

latest.description: the newest version the add-on's update URL names

CheckSelfUpdateRequest.description: the newest release of this add-on on GitHub (administrators)

current.description: the installed version (VERSION file), empty if unknown

latest.description: the version of the newest release

installable.description: the release has a checked archive for this CCU and installSelfUpdate can install it here

InstallSelfUpdateRequest.description: downloads the newest release, checks its SHA256 checksum and runs its update_script, without rebooting the CCU; the server restarts a few seconds after the answer (elevated administrators)

Addon.description: An add-on as its rc.d script describes itself (cp_software.cgi)

newPassword.description: the WebUI's allowed characters, not empty

ProgramUsage.description: A program using channels of a device (ChnEnumDPUsagePrograms)

VirtualKey.description: A virtual key of the CCU (HM-RCV-50, HmIP-RCV-50)

programs.description: how many programs use the key

started.description: the start time, which identifies the test

answered.description: when the device answered, empty while it hasn't

directDownload.description: The CCU can download the update itself (downloadCcuFirmware)

freeMb.description: Free space on the CCU's user partition in MB, for information

version.description: the logic layer to start next time (/etc/config/ReGaHssVersion)

DiagramSeries.description: A line of a diagram: a channel's datapoint, or a system variable (address "sysvar", datapoint its id)

chart.description: How the series is drawn; empty lets the app choose

aggregate.description: What is shown of an interval; delta is the increase of a counter (consumption)

places.description: Rooms, trades and favorite lists (ReGa ids) that show the diagram as a tile

EnergyPrice.description: Prices of electricity and gas per kWh (/etc/config/energyPrice)

InfoLed.description: Whether the CCU3's info LED shows service messages and alarms

StorageInfo.description: Bytes the recorded diagram values take and of their file system

password.description: For a new WebUI session, when the last answer was PASSWORD_REQUIRED

HeatingGroupCandidate.description: A channel a heating group may contain

sessionTimeout.description: Seconds until an idle WebUI session ends (rega.conf)

snmp.description: whether the SNMP agent is set up (snmpd-ccu3.conf)

sshPassword.description: A new SSH password (root); empty keeps it

password.description: For a new WebUI session, when the last answer was PASSWORD_REQUIRED

LanGateway.description: A LAN gateway of BidCos-RF (rfd.conf) or BidCos-Wired (hs485d.conf)

LanGatewayState.description: A LAN gateway with its connection state

RadioModule.description: A radio module of an interface (listBidcosInterfaces)

CertificateInfo.description: The HTTPS certificate of the WebUI (/etc/config/server.pem)

snmpPassword.description: at least 8 characters, needed to switch on; never logged

password.description: the user's CCU password when no WebUI session is kept

time.description: Unix seconds the value was last set

DeviceHealth.description: what a device's maintenance channel reports (get_device_health.tcl)

values.description: LOW_BAT, OPERATING_VOLTAGE, RSSI_DEVICE, RSSI_PEER, UNREACH, STICKY_UNREACH, CONFIG_PENDING, UPDATE_PENDING, DUTY_CYCLE, SABOTAGE when the device has them

lowBatLimit.description: HmIP: the voltage at which the device reports LOW_BAT (MASTER LOW_BAT_LIMIT)

GetInterfacesRequest.description: The connected interfaces (BidCos-RF, HmIP-RF, VirtualDevices; BidCos-Wired only with a Wired gateway). Administrators

SearchWiredDevicesRequest.description: Searches the RS485 bus of BidCos-Wired for new devices (hs485d searchDevices, as cp_add_device.cgi action_wir_search); they land in the inbox. Admin with admin token

DeviceFirmwareFile.description: A device firmware on the CCU (a directory in /etc/config/firmware)

DeviceFirmwareVersion.description: The newest firmware eQ-3 offers for a device type (type in lower case)

deviceType.description: The device type as the CCU names it

password.description: The user's password when the server needs a new WebUI session (PASSWORD_REQUIRED)
The user's password when the server needs a new WebUI session (PASSWORD_REQUIRED)
The user's password when the server needs a new WebUI session (PASSWORD_REQUIRED)

SystemState.description: the CCU's hardware and system state as the WebUI's help page (help.cgi), only on the CCU

RuleCondition.description: a channel's datapoint compared with a value; booleans as 1 and 0, enums by index

NotificationRule.description: push notification once all conditions hold for minutes, inside the time window if set (pkg/rules)

message.description: the notification's text; empty uses summary

summary.description: the conditions in words, written by the app

DeviceImageShape.description: marks a channel in the picture, in fractions of its size (webui.js DrawForm)

DeviceImage.description: a device type's picture from the WebUI's DEVDB.tcl

channels.description: shapes per channel (form names of DEVDB.tcl: 1, 1+2, ...)

images.description: by device type in lower case

EndElevationRequest.description: Gives up the admin rights before they expire: the admin token of this device stops working
